signature.name: VTask.applyOrderedFinpartition
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} -> [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] -> {E : Type u_2} -> [NormedAddCommGroup E] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] -> {F : Type u_3} -> [NormedAddCommGroup F] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] -> {n : ℕ} -> (c : OrderedFinpartition n) -> (p : (i : Fin c.length) → E [×c.partSize i]→L[𝕜] F) -> (Fin n → E) → Fin c.length → F

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total and imposes no junk-value conventions; it is well-defined for all valid inputs without any special sentinel behaviour.

facts.statement: ∀ {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : ℕ} (c : OrderedFinpartition n) (p q : (i : Fin c.length) → E [×c.partSize i]→L[𝕜] F) (v : Fin n → E) (m : Fin c.length), p m = q m → VTask.applyOrderedFinpartition c p v m = VTask.applyOrderedFinpartition c q v m
